teaser: One Human, Nine Agents, Nineteen Hours is on Leanpub: free as a minimum, pay what you want, every update included.
core_idea: Dinis Cruz's book One Human, Nine Agents, Nineteen Hours is on Leanpub from 14 November 2026: the day nine AI agents built his talk in nineteen hours, told as a factory with its five steps, its stop file and its failures, and then how a reader can start with one agent, one page of rules, one brief and one finished piece of work. Free minimum, 19 dollars suggested, 90% complete, updates free for every reader.
